observations.scope: Separate generator PID, own migrated PostgreSQL, real TCP/API, generated accounts. Fixed 30s warmups and planned full durations except explicitly labeled pilot. Shared host, no production capacity or causal speedup claims; percentiles are empirical and require separate uncertainty analysis.

descriptive_metrics.method: Linear empirical quantiles, sample SD and IQR. Successful and failed operations separated. Operation time includes token refresh and response validation; queue delay separate. Five-minute buckets describe temporal variation; last buckets may be partial. No population CI/P99 or causal branch difference: one local time series, dependent requests, shared host. Resources include the in-process API and pytest observer, not database CPU/RAM. RSS high-water/retention does not alone prove a memory leak.

limitations: One local execution per plateau; no causal branch comparison or production capacity claim.
Client operation times include token refresh when required; generator queue delay is separate.
Refresh counts include warmup. Warmup requests are excluded from measured phase totals.
Shared PC; a small real-provider transport probe ran during LOAD-01. No physical device.
Raw latency distributions are empirical, without a claim of stable population P99.

transport_findings.interpretation: Transport failure observed, not an HTTP error response. Fixture forces 1s server keepalive; client defaults differ. Keepalive reuse race/resource scheduling are hypotheses, not proven product defects. Revalidate with aligned expiry and isolated timing before changing product.

completion_meaning: Planned experiment variants executed and integrity checked; completion does not mean zero measured transport failures. Findings remain explicit.
